title: Understanding a Benefit Claim Process
context: You work as a Business Analyst for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP). The team has drafted a BPMN diagram showing how a Universal Credit claim is processed from submission to payment. Review the diagram and answer the comprehension questions below.
instructions: Open the provided BPMN diagram and study the process flow. Answer the multiple-choice questions about the process structure, roles, and decision points.

questions.question: How many lanes are in the pool?
What type of gateway is used for the eligibility decision?
What happens when a claim is rejected at the eligibility check?
options: The claimant is notified and given an appeal option
The claim is sent to a manager
questions.correct_answer: The claimant is notified and given an appeal option

questions.question: Which element represents a regulatory control point in this process?
What is the purpose of the audit trail task in this process?
options: To record the decision for compliance purposes
To assign work to a case worker
questions.correct_answer: To record the decision for compliance purposes
